//: Deno config for the edge functions in ./functions/ and their tests.
WHY IT LIVES HERE and not one directory down: the Supabase CLI reads
supabase/functions/deno.json as DEPLOY configuration (the fallback import
map for every function it bundles). A test harness has no business being
read by the deployer, so it sits one level up, where the CLI does not look.
WHY NOT AT THE REPO ROOT: a deno.json beside package.json makes Deno adopt
the whole npm dependency tree (vitest, playwright, jsdom, ...) into
deno.lock — 1,400 lines of noise that has nothing to do with edge
functions. Anchoring the config here keeps ./deno.lock to the handful of
remote URLs the functions actually import.
Run from this directory (or via `deno task --config supabase/deno.json`):
deno task test    the unit tests
deno task check   type-check every function and shared module
CI runs both — see .github/workflows/build.yml and deploy-functions.yml.
